title: Priority: the store identity checks the Fly app name
evidence: app/lib/store.server.ts storeIdentity({ flyAppName, shopDomain }) trims the domain and, on Fly, requires health-tool-app = brand and health-tool-edu = edu, a plain *.myshopify.com host and one of the two known shops; otherwise ownStore() returns null, logs and reports one Sentry error (app name, store kinds, reason; never the domain). trending-cron.server.ts builds no cron and the manual trigger refuses when ownStore() is null, so no lock is taken. Off Fly the domain alone decides, as before
durability_check: app/lib/store.server.test.ts (every app/domain pair, unset, whitespace, trailing newline, wrong host, unknown app); app/lib/trending-cron.store-identity.test.ts (mismatch cases: no lock, no admin call, no write, manual trigger refuses, one Sentry error without the domain)
